name: Mondai no Aru Share House
original_name: 問題のあるシェアハウス
source:
You've gotten yourself a live-in job as a sharehouse manager.
Turns out this sharehouse's residents have some problems!
This might just mark the beginning of your love story under a shared roof...

[Translated from [url=https://sharehouse.favary.co.jp]official website[/url]]
